narration.full_text: Let's test your understanding of linear equations! Question one: Define a pair of linear equations in two variables. [pause 3 seconds] A pair of linear equations involves two equations with the same two variables, whose solution satisfies both simultaneously. Question two: Write the general form of a linear equation in two variables. [pause 3 seconds] The general form is ax + by + c = 0, where a, b, and c are real numbers, and a and b are not both zero. Question three: Solve graphically the equations x minus y equals two, and x plus y equals six. [pause 3 seconds] The solution is x equals four, y equals two. Finally, question four: Solve the equations x plus y equals ten, and x minus y equals two. [pause 3 seconds] The solution is x equals six, y equals four. Great job!
